newsitem.title: FRANCE: RUGBY UNION-BRIVE JOIN TOULOUSE IN SEMIFINALS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-BRIVE JOIN TOULOUSE IN SEMIFINALS.

text.p: France's Brive joined holders Toulouse in the semifinals of the European Cup on Sunday after a comfortable 35-14 victory over Llanelli.
Brive, the losing finalists to Toulouse in the French championship last season, proved far too powerful for their Welsh counterparts.

The one-sided match looked like a dress rehearsal for the team from central France ahead of a far trickier semifinal clash against another Welsh side, Cardiff, who lost the European Cup final to Toulouse last spring.
Toulouse will travel to England's Leicester in the other semifinal in the first weekend in January..
Full-back Christophe Lamaison took full advantage of Brive's domination to score 25 points with seven penalties and two conversions.
Llanelli's main weapon was experienced Welsh wing Ieuan Evans, who scored two tries while the French were losing momentum.
But Brive, who rapidly opened the floodgates with a try from number eight Thierry Labrousse in the fifth minute, were never in serious danger.
Centre David Venditti scored Brive's second try in the end of the first half while catching a clever kick from fly-half Alain Penaud.
Brive have yet to lose a match in the European Cup this season, a record which will allow them to host Cardiff in January.
